subproblem.title: Area bounds for a 1-Lipschitz graph over an n-plane
subproblem.statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, ξ ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ |v − w| for all v, w, and Φ(v) := ξ + ιv + ι'f(v). Then for every measurable set A ⊆ ℝⁿ and every measurable h : ℝ^{n+k} → [0, ∞]: ∫_A h(Φ(v)) dLⁿ(v) ≤ ∫_{Φ(A)} h dHⁿ ≤ ∫_A (1 + 2ⁿ Σ_{i=1}^{n} |Df(v)e_i|²) h(Φ(v)) dLⁿ(v). Here Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+k}, Lⁿ = volume on ℝⁿ, Df(v) = fderiv ℝ f v (0 where f is not differentiable), e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1, the weight is ENNReal.ofReal of the displayed real number, and all integrals are lower Lebesgue integrals.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → MeasurableSet A → Measurable h → (∫⁻ v in A, h (ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) ≤ ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' A, h x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' A, h x ∂μHE[n] ≤ ∫⁻ v in A, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 ^ n * ∑ i : Fin n, ‖fderiv ℝ f v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * h (ξ + ι v + ι' (f v))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof Step 6 (area formula for the injective Lipschitz graph map, J_f ∈ [1, 2^{n/2}], |J_f − 1| ≤ C|Df|²) and Step 9 (J_f ≤ 2^{n/2}); Simon Ch. 5, (14)–(15), and the area formula Simon Ch. 2, 3.5. Write J_Φ(v) := (det(DΦ(v)^*DΦ(v)))^{1/2} where Φ is differentiable at v, J_Φ(v) := 0 otherwise (Lean: areaJacobianAt Φ v = (fderiv ℝ Φ v).normDet).
1. Φ is injective. If Φ(v) = Φ(w) then ι(v − w) = ι'(f(w) − f(v)); taking the inner product with ι(v − w), and using that ι is an isometry and ⟨ιu, ι'u'⟩ = 0, gives |v − w|² = |ι(v − w)|² = ⟨ι(v − w), ι'(f(w) − f(v))⟩ = 0, so v = w.
2. Φ is 2-Lipschitz: |Φ(v) − Φ(w)| ≤ |ι(v − w)| + |ι'(f(v) − f(w))| = |v − w| + |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ 2|v − w|.
3. Area formula. For an injective Lipschitz map Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k}, a measurable A ⊆ ℝⁿ and any g : ℝ^{n+k} → [0, ∞], ∫_{Φ(A)} g dHⁿ = ∫_A J_Φ(v) g(Φ(v)) dLⁿ(v) (Simon Ch. 2, 3.5–3.7; Federer 3.2.3). It is proved, with axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound only, in the pinned SimonGMT package as Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.weighted_area_formula_lipschitz_injOn (file Poincare/SimonGMT/Chapter02/AreaLipschitz.lean; add `import Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.AreaLipschitz` to the import block of GMT/Ch07/Submission.lean — adding a SimonGMT import has precedent in the accepted node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.im_sub-a1, commit 77fcc7d). Its measure is μHE[finrank ℝ (Euclid n)] = μHE[n] (finrank_euclideanSpace_fin), and its Jacobian is areaJacobianAt Φ v, whose square is det(DΦ(v)^*DΦ(v)) (areaJacobianAt_sq_eq_det_adjoint_comp).
4. Differentiability. By Rademacher's theorem (LipschitzWith.ae_differentiableAt) f is differentiable at Lⁿ-a.e. v. Fix such a v and put B := Df(v) : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ. Since f is 1-Lipschitz, ‖B‖ ≤ 1 (norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz), so |Be_i| ≤ 1 for every i. Φ is differentiable at v with DΦ(v) = ι + ι'∘B.
5. Gram operator. For u, w ∈ ℝⁿ, ⟨DΦ(v)u, DΦ(v)w⟩ = ⟨ιu, ιw⟩ + ⟨ιu, ι'Bw⟩ + ⟨ι'Bu, ιw⟩ + ⟨ι'Bu, ι'Bw⟩ = ⟨u, w⟩ + ⟨Bu, Bw⟩. The two middle terms vanish by orthogonality, and ι, ι' preserve inner products. Hence DΦ(v)^*DΦ(v) = I + P with P := B^*B.
6. Spectrum. P is self-adjoint with 0 ≤ ⟨Pu, u⟩ = |Bu|² ≤ |u|². By the spectral theorem P has an orthonormal eigenbasis with eigenvalues λ_1, …, λ_n ∈ [0, 1], and Σ_iλ_i = trace P = Σ_i⟨Pe_i, e_i⟩ = Σ_i|Be_i|² =: t(v).
7. Determinant. det(I + P) = Π_i(1 + λ_i) ≥ 1. Claim: for m ≥ 1 and λ_1, …, λ_m ∈ [0, 1], Π_{i≤m}(1 + λ_i) ≤ 1 + 2^{m−1}S_m with S_m := Σ_{i≤m}λ_i. For m = 1 this is an equality. If it holds for m, then Π_{i≤m+1}(1 + λ_i) ≤ (1 + λ_{m+1})(1 + 2^{m−1}S_m) = 1 + 2^{m−1}S_m + λ_{m+1} + λ_{m+1}2^{m−1}S_m ≤ 1 + 2^mS_m + λ_{m+1} ≤ 1 + 2^mS_{m+1}, using λ_{m+1} ≤ 1 and 1 ≤ 2^m. With m = n ≥ 1: 1 ≤ J_Φ(v)² = det(I + P) ≤ 1 + 2^{n−1}t(v).
8. Since J_Φ(v) ≥ 0 and J_Φ(v)² ≥ 1, we get J_Φ(v) ≥ 1, hence J_Φ(v) ≤ J_Φ(v)² ≤ 1 + 2^{n−1}t(v) ≤ 1 + 2ⁿΣ_i|Df(v)e_i|². So 1 ≤ J_Φ(v) ≤ 1 + 2ⁿΣ_i|Df(v)e_i|² for Lⁿ-a.e. v.
9. Integration. Multiply the a.e. inequalities of step 8 (read in [0, ∞] through ENNReal.ofReal) by h(Φ(v)) ∈ [0, ∞]. Integrate over A, using monotonicity of the lower integral under a.e. inequalities for the restricted measure (lintegral_mono_ae), and use step 3 with g := h. This gives ∫_A h(Φ(v)) dv ≤ ∫_A J_Φ(v)h(Φ(v)) dv = ∫_{Φ(A)} h dHⁿ ≤ ∫_A ofReal(1 + 2ⁿΣ_i|Df(v)e_i|²) h(Φ(v)) dv, which is the claim. ∎
proof_key_steps: Φ(v) = ξ + ιv + ι'f(v) is injective and 2-Lipschitz.
Area formula for injective Lipschitz maps (SimonGMT weighted_area_formula_lipschitz_injOn): ∫_{Φ(A)} h dHⁿ = ∫_A J_Φ h∘Φ dv.
Rademacher: a.e. DΦ = ι + ι'Df with ‖Df‖ ≤ 1, and DΦ^*DΦ = I + Df^*Df.
Eigenvalues of Df^*Df lie in [0, 1] and sum to Σ_i|Df e_i|²; 1 ≤ det(I + Df^*Df) ≤ 1 + 2^{n−1}Σ_i|Df e_i|² by induction.
1 ≤ J_Φ ≤ J_Φ² ≤ 1 + 2ⁿΣ_i|Df e_i|² a.e.; integrate against h∘Φ.

audit.reason: Injectivity, Rademacher, the compatible area formula and the explicit determinant estimate establish both weighted lower-integral bounds. The proof handles almost-everywhere differentiability and arbitrary measurable ENNReal weights.
